description: The first CLI and MCP server for RocketCyber Managed SOC, with triage and posture analytics no console page or API call computes.

novel_features.name: Morning triage board
novel_features.description: One ranked board of open incidents, event verdict counts, and offline agents across every client account.

novel_features.name: Incident MTTR
novel_features.description: Mean and median time-to-resolve plus open-incident aging buckets, computed from incident created/resolved timestamps.

novel_features.name: Stale agent detection
novel_features.description: Devices that stopped reporting beyond a time window, grouped by client account.

novel_features.name: Defender riskiest devices
novel_features.description: Devices-at-risk ranked by weighted malicious and suspicious detection counts.

novel_features.name: Secure-score trend
novel_features.description: First/last/delta/direction computed over the Microsoft 365 secure-score daily series.

novel_features.name: Suppression audit
novel_features.description: Alert-suppression rules classified by status and age, flagging stale rules that may hide real detections.
